dimensions.prompt:
DIMENSION: Schematic electrical correctness of the FlatSat bench additions.
Check from netlist.xml and the sheets bench_io, emulator_mcu, solar_emulation, solar_power_injection, battery_protection_replica, pyro_inhibit: floating inputs, missing pull-ups/pull-downs and their values, voltage-domain mismatches where the 3V3_EMU emulator domain meets the FC's +3V3 domain (TCA4311A U300/U310-U316 bus buffers: VCC side, enable, READY), I2C address conflicts on each emulated face bus (TMP112 U301, VEML6031 U302, DRV2605L U303 behind U300), RP2350 U200 GPIO assignment conflicts, USB-C J701/J510 CC resistors and VBUS handling, RUN/BOOTSEL (SW701/SW702), WDT_DISABLE / USBBOOT control transistors Q701-Q703 (BSS138) and whether they can back-drive the FC when the emulator is unpowered. Triage ERC errors: real vs library noise. The FC sheets are a frozen copy of flown FC_V5e_Production_Rev2; only report FC items if a FlatSat addition changes their behavior.

DIMENSION: Schematic vs datasheet parity, BENCH POWER.
Parts: BQ25886 U511 (2S boost charger: ILIM, ICHGSET R515, VSET, TS network, BTST cap, PMID/SYS/BAT caps, L510 SPM6530T-1R0M120 value and saturation vs peak current), DMP4047LFDE Q510 (VBUS_CHG reverse/blocking), R5460N208AA U500 + IRF7458 Q500/Q501 (2-cell protection replica: thresholds, delay caps, gate drive), AP2112K-3.3 U202 (3V3_EMU LDO: input/output caps, load vs 600 mA), RP2350 internal VREG (L200 3.3 uH, VREG_AVDD filter, caps per RP2350 hardware design guide), VSOLAR injection path (F400/F401 PTC 1.85 A, D400/D401 CDBA240LL Schottky, JP400/JP401) and the pyro inhibit replica (BAT54W D600-D602, SW600, JP600-JP607). Compare each against the datasheet typical application. Check that nothing new sits in series with a flight power path. Report only deviations that matter or missing datasheet-required components.

DIMENSION: Schematic vs datasheet parity, EMULATOR DIGITAL AND SENSORS.
Parts: RP2350A U200 (QFN-60: decoupling per rail, IOVDD/DVDD/USB_OTP_VDD/ADC_AVDD/VREG_VIN, crystal Y200 ABM8-272-T3 load caps and series R vs the RP2350 hardware design guide and minimal design, USB series R, QSPI_SS pull-up and BOOTSEL), W25Q128JVS U201 (pull-ups on /WP /HOLD or QSPI use, decoupling), TCA4311A x8 (EN, READY, VCC decoupling, pull-ups on both sides, rise time), TMP112 U301 (ADD0 strap, ALERT), VEML6031X00 U302 (supply, address), DRV2605L U303 (IN/TRIG, EN, output to J300 'Coil Out', REG cap), SWD J702, bench header J703. Report only deviations that matter or missing datasheet-required components.

DIMENSION: PCB layout correctness and manufacturability of the FlatSat bench area.
Triage drc.json by class; the known baseline items are U6.1/U6.29 unconnected, SW2/TP2 courtyard, 12x annular_width on heritage U6 pad 29 (KiCad 10.0.6 also reports them on flown Rev2), footprint_type_mismatch on U200 (same footprint as flown U18), isolated_copper and lib_footprint_issues identical to Rev2 or due to missing global libs. Then check the new area: via-in-pad (the owner ruled every new via moves off-pad or is listed for filled-and-capped; check the remaining list in the context), RP2350 U200 escape inside the EMU_FANOUT rule area (0.127 mm clearance, 0.40/0.20 vias) against JLCPCB 4-layer capability, QSPI U200-U201 routing, thermal reliefs and copper width on the BenchPower/FCPower nets, silkscreen over pads, H10-H12 keepouts, the J12 relief slot, edge clearance, connector pin-1, the 37 attachment stubs into the flight section. Use python on the S-expression or pcbnew if helpful.

DIMENSION: PCB layout vs datasheet layout recommendations, FlatSat bench area.
BQ25886 U511 (input cap loop, SW node area, BTST, PMID/SYS caps at the pins, EP thermal vias, sense paths), RP2350 U200 (decoupling distance per pin from pos.csv and pads, VREG_LX loop with L200 and its caps, crystal Y200 trace length and ground, USB pair to J701, QSPI to U201 per the hardware design guide), AP2112K U202 caps, TCA4311A placement near the face connectors they buffer, DRV2605L output loop, IRF7458/R5460N protection replica current path width vs the bench battery current (IPC-2221 estimate). Report only material deviations.

DIMENSION: Bench/FlatSat test-fixture practice (this board never flies; 'BENCH ONLY - NOT FOR FLIGHT').
It must faithfully host the frozen flight-controller copy while letting a bench user emulate solar panels, faces, battery and pyro inhibits safely. Check: can any bench supply (J400/J401 VSOLAR injection, J500 bench PSU, J510 USB-C charger, J701 emulator USB) back-feed or over-voltage an FC rail or another bench supply in any jumper state of the J500 mode table and JP400-JP607; are PTC/Schottky protections sized for plausible bench faults (reversed leads on J400/J401/J500); do the emulated face buses isolate cleanly when the emulator is unpowered; are test points provided for every rail and control a bring-up engineer needs; is the SAFE/ARMED SW600 behavior fail-safe; ESD exposure on bench connectors. Only report gaps that create real damage risk to the FC copy, the bench user, or test validity.
